audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases.side (Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill) contradicts content-layer win[] (Skill, Skill, Maokai x5) on every row.

audit.why: Spikes correctly identify level 6 (Nature's Grasp wave-wide root) and first item (tank stats blunting Starcall poke while root windows persist) as Maokai's power spikes, grounded in his kit.

audit.why: Twisted Advance (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s by rank and Nature's Grasp (R) is 130/110/90s. Concrete numbers let the reader count the window instead of relying on vague language.
